name: Koyamachou Watch Repair Shop
source:
In the corner of an aging arcade lies a watch repair shop. Suddenly thrust into taking over ownership of the shop, as you learn the craft of watch repair you'll deepen your relationship with the customers and people of the arcade. Going over the notes of the prior owner, the old days of the store and area will come back to life.

[from [url=https://wandeer.itch.io/watch-repair-shop]itch.io[/url]]
